sections.section_title: TIM6 and TIM7 event generation register (TIMx_EGR)
sections.text_helper: Section 17.4.5 "TIM6 and TIM7 event generation register (TIMx_EGR)" in chapter 17 (Basic timers (TIM6 and TIM7)), RM0008 Rev 21, page 479.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x14
Reset value: 0x0000
Bits 15:1 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bit 0 UG: Update generation
This bit can be set by software, it is automatically cleared by hardware.
0: No action.
1: Re-initializes the timer counter and generates an update of the registers. Note that the
prescaler counter is cleared too (but the prescaler ratio is not affected).
